excerpt: Quince is a San Francisco online retailer selling cashmere, silk, leather, bedding and home goods at low prices through a factory-direct model. Valued at $10.1B after a $500M Series E in March 2026.
content:
Quince is an online store for everyday essentials made from premium materials: Mongolian cashmere sweaters, washable silk, Italian leather bags and shoes, Turkish cotton towels, bedding, furniture, jewellery, activewear and more. Its pitch is luxury-grade quality at much lower prices. Quince's About page says it keeps prices low with a factory-direct model that cuts out sourcing agents, warehousing, wholesaling, distribution and storefront retail, shipping from partner factories to the customer, and that it aims to be open about materials, manufacturing and pricing. It calls this a manufacturer-to-consumer model. The site offers free shipping and returns for 365 days.

Quince is headquartered in San Francisco. Wikipedia lists its founders as Sid Gupta, Sourabh Mahajan, Becky Mortimer and Zunu Mittal; Gupta is CEO and Mahajan is CTO. It started as Last Brand and rebranded to Quince in June 2020.

The company has grown quickly. According to Wikipedia, in January 2025 it raised a $120 million Series C led by Notable Capital and Wellington Management. Bloomberg reported in July 2025 that it was raising about $200 million at a valuation of more than $4.5 billion, led by Iconiq. On 11 March 2026 Quince announced a $500 million Series E led by ICONIQ at a $10.1 billion valuation, with Basis Set Ventures, Wellington Management, WndrCo, Baillie Gifford, Notable Capital and DST Global among the investors, Retail Dive and FashionUnited reported. Reports said it passed $1 billion in revenue in 2025. Quince has also faced legal disputes: Wikipedia notes a November 2025 lawsuit from Williams-Sonoma over comparative advertising claims, and trademark disputes with Yeti and Deckers (UGG).

Prices are set per product on the site. This profile draws on Quince's own pages and published reporting. We have not bought from Quince, and nothing here is paid placement.
